name: camunda-bpmn-preview-tooling
description: Offline preview smoke tooling for camunda-bpmn-from-context

scripts.preview:smoke: node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('child_process'); const {resolve}=require('path'); if (!process.env.PREVIEW_DIR) { console.error('PREVIEW_DIR is required for preview:smoke'); process.exit(1); } const env={...process.env, PREVIEW_PLAYWRIGHT_PROJECTS:'chromium', NODE_PATH: resolve(__dirname,'node_modules')}; const result=spawnSync(process.execPath,['./node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js','test','--config','../tests/preview/playwright.config.ts','../tests/preview'],{stdio:'inherit',env}); process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
scripts.preview:smoke:matrix: node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('child_process'); const {resolve}=require('path'); if (!process.env.PREVIEW_DIR) { console.error('PREVIEW_DIR is required for preview:smoke:matrix'); process.exit(1); } const env={...process.env, PREVIEW_PLAYWRIGHT_PROJECTS:'chromium,firefox,webkit', NODE_PATH: resolve(__dirname,'node_modules')}; const result=spawnSync(process.execPath,['./node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js','test','--config','../tests/preview/playwright.config.ts','../tests/preview'],{stdio:'inherit',env}); process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
